name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Marketing Operations & Analytics | HubSpot, CRM Integrations, GA4 & Revenue Attribution
summary: Marketing operations builder who sets the system and then builds it: CRM architecture in HubSpot and GoHighLevel, the integrations and sync logic that connect it to the rest of the business, and the tracking, attribution, and dashboards that show leadership what marketing contributes to pipeline. 5+ years building CRM and marketing automation (lifecycle stages, lead scoring, routing, data governance) on top of 15+ years in B2B SaaS and agency roles, including long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles sold to C-suite buyers. Works in SQL, Power BI, GA4, and Google Tag Manager, and documents every system so it outlasts the person who built it.

experience.title: Marketing Operations & Analytics (Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead)
bullets: Architect and administer CRM and marketing automation systems in HubSpot and GoHighLevel, setting the standards for properties, lifecycle stages, lead scoring, segmentation, and data-hygiene rules.
Built 20+ workflows covering lead capture, routing, qualification, booking, onboarding nurture, and reactivation, so every inbound lead reaches the right next step without manual handoff.
Integrate CRMs with business systems through Zapier, Make, and n8n using webhooks and REST APIs, owning field mapping, sync logic, and data quality across connected tools.
Install Google Tag Manager and GA4 tracking on every site I build, and query GA4 data in BigQuery and SQL to model performance in Power BI.
Build dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, and present the findings and recommendations to business owners.
Diagnosed a client's Google Ads account end to end, cutting spam and low-quality leads and identifying on-site conversion as the remaining bottleneck.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Built campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, and presented the results and recommendations in client QBRs.
Managed ~3 client accounts at $20K+/month in ad spend each (peaking above $100K/month), advising on budget allocation across paid channels.
Ran account-based LinkedIn campaigns against small, highly researched target-account lists with A/B-tested setups.

bullets: Managed 15-20 reseller partners selling Birdeye through a multi-channel model (deals ~$10K-$45K), retaining all but one (~94%), in a Salesforce stack with ZoomInfo and intent data synced in.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance data to find adoption gaps and recommend fixes that reduced churn.

Closed 6 deals averaging ~$22K (~$130K+ total bookings) and reached the finalist stage of a long-cycle pursuit of a major banking prospect.

Led multiple onboarding teams of up to 30 specialists while onboarding 25+ clients per month at 120% of sales and 110% of implementation targets.
